from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors import CalcMolFormula
import numpy as np, sys

A='c1c(F)c(F)c(F)c(F)c1F'
D='c1c(C(C)C)cccc1C(C)C'
tag=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else '@'
smi = f"CC1=[N+]({D})[Sn-]2[N+]({D})=C(C)[C{tag}H]1P=C(O2)/C(=C/[B-]({A})({A}){A})c3ccccc3"
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
assert m
print(CalcMolFormula(m), Chem.GetFormalCharge(m))
# identify key atoms
patt = Chem.MolFromSmarts('[CH1]([P])([CX3]=[N+])[CX3]=[N+]')
mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3()
ps.randomSeed=0xf00d
ps.useRandomCoords=True
cids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh,numConfs=8,params=ps)
print('confs',len(cids))
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mh,maxIters=2000)
print(res[:3])
# pick best
best=min(range(len(cids)), key=lambda i: res[i][1] if res[i][1] is not None else 1e9)
Chem.MolToMolFile(mh,f'build_{"p" if tag=="@" else "m"}.mol',confId=cids[best])
# compute chirality sign
matches=mh.GetSubstructMatches(Chem.MolFromSmarts('[CH1X4]([PX2])([CX3]=[N+])[CX3]=[N+]'))
print('matches',matches)
conf=mh.GetConformer(cids[best])
pos=np.array(conf.GetPositions())
mt=matches[0]
ch,p,c1,n1,c2,n2=mt
# determine which C leads to N that is in 7-ring with O

# find 7-ring containing O

ring7=[r for r in ri.AtomRings() if o_idx in r][0]

else: cA,cB=c2,c1
v1=pos[p]-pos[ch]; v2=pos[cA]-pos[ch]; v3=pos[cB]-pos[ch]
sign=np.dot(v1,np.cross(v2,v3))

import numpy as np
def read(f):
    L=open(f).read().split('\n')
    n=int(L[0]); sym=[];pos=[]
    for l in L[2:2+n]:
        p=l.split(); sym.append(p[0]); pos.append([float(x) for x in p[1:4]])
    return sym,np.array(pos)
s,p=read('opt_ff.xyz')
import itertools
def d(i,j): return np.linalg.norm(p[i]-p[j])
print('Sn-N',d(15,2),d(15,16),'Sn-O',d(15,34))
print('P-C31',d(32,31),'P=C33',d(32,33),'O-C33',d(34,33))
print('C35=C36',d(35,36),'C36-B',d(36,37))
# dihedral
def dih(a,b,c,dd):
    b0=p[a]-p[b]; b1=p[c]-p[b]; b2=p[dd]-p[c]
    b1/=np.linalg.norm(b1)
    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1)*b1; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1)*b1
    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.dot(np.cross(b1,v),w),np.dot(v,w)))
print('dih 33-35-36-37',dih(33,35,36,37))
# chirality
v1=p[32]-p[31]; v2=p[29]-p[31]; v3=p[25]-p[31]
print('triple',np.dot(v1,np.cross(v2,v3)))
EOF

def read(f):
    L=open(f).read().split('\n'); n=int(L[0]); sym=[];pos=[]
    for l in L[2:2+n]:
        q=l.split(); sym.append(q[0]); pos.append([float(x) for x in q[1:4]])
    return sym,np.array(pos)
s,p=read('opt_gfn2.xyz')
d=lambda i,j: np.linalg.norm(p[i]-p[j])
print('Sn-N',d(15,2),d(15,16),'Sn-O',d(15,34))
print('P-C31',d(32,31),'P=C33',d(32,33),'O-C33',d(34,33))
print('C35=C36',d(35,36),'C36-B',d(36,37),'C35-C33',d(35,33))
def dih(a,b,c,e):
    b0=p[a]-p[b]; b1=p[c]-p[b]; b2=p[e]-p[c]; b1=b1/np.linalg.norm(b1)
    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1)*b1; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1)*b1
    return np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.dot(np.cross(b1,v),w),np.dot(v,w)))
print('dih',dih(33,35,36,37))
v1=p[32]-p[31]; v2=p[29]-p[31]; v3=p[25]-p[31]
print('triple',np.dot(v1,np.cross(v2,v3)))

from itertools import combinations
mind=1e9
for i,j in combinations(range(len(p)),2):
